facts.value: Imperial assesses Home/Overseas status after application under UK regulations. A questionnaire is requested only when needed. Settled status and ordinary residence, generally three years before the first academic year, have exceptions; nationality alone is insufficient. September courses use 1 September as the first academic-year date. ELQ status is separately assessed, with STEM and some healthcare exemptions; affected higher charges are stated with an offer. Appeal before enrolment within one calendar month of initial assessment; status cannot be amended after starting.

country_and_region_panels.published_text: Applicants may be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA, etc, on a case by case basis provided that they have graduated with an overall mark of at least 8.5/10.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA, etc, applicants should have completed a Diplome d'Etat, Diplome d'Ingenieur or Ingenieur d'Etat with a final overall mark of at least 16/20.
Doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should also hold a Magister degree, normally with at least 16/20.

Postgraduate taught study
Applicants may be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MPH, MEd, MBA, etc, on a case by case basis provided that they have graduated with a Bàtxelor with a minimum grade of 7/10. Usually, a grade of 8/10 is preferred.
Doctoral study
Applicants may be considered for admission to a postgraduate doctoral course if they hold:
a Bàtxelor degree; and
a Master's degree with grades specified above.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should have completed a Grau de Mestre with a minimum grade of 15/20 or better.
Doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should seek advice from the relevant Admissions team.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should have:
completed a minimum of 4 years of study; and
been awarded the Licenciado with an overall grade of at least 7.5/10 from a mainstream university.
Doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should also hold a Magister degree with at least 7.5/10 from a mainstream university.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should have:
completed a minimum of 4 years of study; and
been awarded the Bakalavr with an overall average grade of 4.5/5 or better.
Doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should hold a Master's degree with a grade of 4/5 or better, although a grade of 4.5/5 is normally preferred.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA, etc, applicants should hold a Bachelor's degree, to Honours level, with a minimum of a Lower Second Class Honours.
A minimum of an Upper Second Class honours is however normally required for most of our courses.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should hold:
a first degree, ideally with Honours; and
a Master's degree.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA, etc, applicants who graduated before the Bologna reforms should hold a Diploma with a grade of 2 or better.
Applicants who graduated after the Bologna reforms should hold a 1st cycle Bachelor's degree of at least 3 years' duration with a grade of 2 or better.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should be in possession of a 2nd cycle Master's degree normally with an overall grade of 2 or better.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should have:
completed five years of study and been awarded the Specialist Diploma; or
completed four years of study and been awarded the Bachelor’s degree.
For both qualifications the requirement is an overall average grade of 4.5/5 or better.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should hold a Master's degree with a grade of 4/5 or better, although a grade of 4.5/5 is normally preferred.

University of Bharain
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should hold a Bachelor's degree from the University of Bahrain with a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or better.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should also hold a Master's degree with a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or better.
Arabian Gulf University
Applicants from the Arabian Gulf University should hold a Bachelor’s degree awarded with 75% or better.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should hold a Master’s degree with Very Good or better.

Postgraduate taught study
To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants from the Bangladesh University of Engineering Technology should have completed a minimum of 4 years of study and have been awarded a Bachelor's degree with 75%.
Postgraduate doctoral study
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should also hold a Master's degree with First Class or better.

To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA, etc, applicants should hold a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of a Lower Second Class Honours from one of the campuses of the University of the West Indies.
A minimum of an Upper Second Class Honours is however normally required for most of our courses.
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should hold a first degree with a First or Upper Second Class Honours and should also be in possession of a Master's degree.

To be considered for admission to a Master's e.g. MSc, MRes, MBA etc, applicants should have completed a minimum of 5 years of study and been awarded a specialist degree or a Bachelor's degree with an overall average grade of 4.5/5 or better.
Where a 10-point grading scheme is used, 9/10 or better is required.
Applicants for a postgraduate doctoral course should be in possession of a Master's degree with a grade of 4/5 or better, although a grade of 4.5/5 is normally preferred.
Where a 10-point grading scheme is used, a grade of 8/10 is required, though 9/10 is normally preferred.
